text: ああ　みえても　オーキドはかせは　ポケモンの　オーソリティなの！

structure.en: even though he looks like that

structure.jp: ポケモンの　オーソリティなの！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: ても means 'even if' or 'even though'. ああ　みえても = 'even though he looks like that'.

patterns.name: 〜の (sentence ending)
patterns.explanation: なの at the end is a soft, often feminine, explanation. オーソリティなの = 'he is an authority, you know'.
